newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares fall in lower turnover.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares fall in lower turnover.

text.p: 1220 GMT - Polish shares fell in lower turnover after a five-session rise and selling was stronger after price fixing. * The main market's WIG index fell 155.3 points, or 1.1 percent, to 14,165.5, the WIG 20 fell 1.3 percent to 1,432 and the parallel market's WIRR fell 0.8 percent to 2,511.1. * Turnover fell 39.8 percent to 78.9 million zlotys on both markets as 58 issues fell, 10 rose and 15 were flat. Sell offers for 15 stocks and buy orders for seven were unmatched. Most active BPH eased 0.5 percent in a 4.0-million -zloty turnover. NFI units fell 5.4 percent in 11-million-zloty trade.
